name: facebookresearch_qinco/qinco/search/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_qinco/qinco/search/pair.build_PairwiseDecoderIVF: build a PairwiseDecoderIVF instance from config and training codes to perform pairwise vector quantization decoding
facebookresearch_qinco/qinco/search/pair.run_forward_decoding: run the forward pass on codes_MB with optional IVF codes to reconstruct quantized vectors
facebookresearch_qinco/qinco/search/pair.compute_dataset_mse: compute the mean squared error between a dataset and its quantized reconstruction using the decoder
facebookresearch_qinco/qinco/search/pair.train_PairwiseDecoderIVF: train the PairwiseDecoderIVF by building IVF small codebooks and greedily selecting best pairwise codebook combinations
facebookresearch_qinco/qinco/search/pair.build_combined_codebook: build a combined codebook from two codebook indices m1 and m2 and compute local reconstruction error

facebookresearch_qinco/qinco/search/sear.run_IVFTrainTask: run the IVFTrainTask to train IVF centroids using faiss K-means on a training vector set
facebookresearch_qinco/qinco/search/sear.run_EncodeDBTask: run the EncodeDBTask to encode a database of vectors using the QINCo model and save codes to npz
facebookresearch_qinco/qinco/search/sear.run_BuildIndexTask: run the BuildIndexTask to build a faiss IVF+RQ index from encoded vectors and IVF centroids
facebookresearch_qinco/qinco/search/sear.run_SearchTask: run the SearchTask to perform approximate nearest neighbor search using an IVF index or full database
facebookresearch_qinco/qinco/search/sear.run_TrainPairwiseDecoderTask: run the TrainPairwiseDecoderTask to train a PairwiseDecoderIVF reranker model on encoded training data

facebookresearch_qinco/qinco/search/sear.batch_db: batch a numpy database array into fixed-size chunks yielding batch index and data
facebookresearch_qinco/qinco/search/sear.show_gpu_memory: show current GPU memory usage in gigabytes using PyTorch CUDA memory info
facebookresearch_qinco/qinco/search/sear.iterate_encoded_db: iterate over partitioned encoded database NPZ files in configurable batch sizes
facebookresearch_qinco/qinco/search/sear.compute_aq_codebooks: compute fixed additive quantization codebooks from training data and codes using least squares
facebookresearch_qinco/qinco/search/sear.reconstruct_vectors: reconstruct original vectors from quantization codes and fixed additive codebooks
